note: Set A correctly binds both wavelength bands for the blue and red channels, all three pixel resolutions, the spectrometer types (IFS/IFS/Slit) and the 0.4 mm DM actuator pitch, with conditions (2.4 λ/D, wavelength) kept and no invented qualifiers. Set B adds useful facts (OWA 0.74/1.57 as, red-channel FOV 2.2", IR spectrometer λ/Δλ = 40) but attaches a spurious "HabEx 4-Meter Baseline Design" condition to the OWA claims and leaves its 1/4 CCD282 (EMCCD) detector claims ambiguous between the camera and spectrometer detector rows. Set A does omit the OWA values, red-channel FOV and telescope resolution 23 mas, but every one of its claims is supported and correctly bound, whereas B is noisier and drops the blue 0.45–0.55 µm band, red 0.82–1.0 µm band, red/IR pixel resolutions and the DM pitch.
